name: FlooringPeriphery extMulticall arbitrary call
summary: Multicall.extMulticall() in the FlooringPeriphery implementation executed caller-supplied (target, callData) pairs from the periphery proxy with no access control. Users had approved the proxy for their NFTs and WETH, so the attacker made it call safeTransferFrom and transferFrom on approval holders and took their BAYC, Pudgy Penguins and WETH.
notes: The NFTs have no DefiLlama price, so they are valued at what the attacker realised selling them into Blur bids within half an hour (the three referenced sales), priced at the ETH rate of each sale (rule 12).

Azuki pulled through the same defect by 0x4526250a2e18dbd7fdd2dd0e49d58d88dc25da4c and 0x0171837c6461f551ab1eb5937374f52d6cefe7bb are not in the campaign: all went back to their owners, directly or via Floor's recovery wallet 0xcf771bfd570a00364dedaba60ad293e06e414301 (rule 5 rescue).
